label: swisstopo terms of use for free geodata and geoservices (OGD)
source: official Federal Office of Topography swisstopo OGD terms and FAQ
finding: swisstopo free geodata may be used, distributed, made accessible, enriched, processed, and used commercially, with mandatory source attribution. Official FAQ explicitly states that Creative Commons licences are not used because they are incompatible with the applicable geoinformation legal basis; the terms are therefore preserved without an invented SPDX identifier.

label: Copernicus DEM free licence / ESA Copernicus Contributing Missions user licence and mission-specific terms
source: official Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem Copernicus DEM collection description and access documentation
finding: The official product page states that GLO-30 and GLO-90 are available worldwide with a free licence and are subject to ESA/Copernicus user-access conditions and mandatory source notices. These terms are preserved as custom non-SPDX terms. Current GLO-30 view-service access requires Copernicus Contributing Missions registration.

label: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International
source: U.S. federal Data.gov metadata harvested for OEDI submission 5773
finding: The item-level federal catalog record for Sample IEEE123 Bus system for OEDI SI explicitly gives https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. The broader AWS GADAL collection currently lists Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 United States; that collection-level metadata is not substituted for the specific OEDI item represented by CR000285.
